text: dsh-freeweb 是为 DSH 接入网页搜索的插件，通过 web seam 注册 freeweb 搜索提供方。它按优先顺序同时调用两个搜索引擎，一个失败时用后续引擎补位，并按跨引擎共识合并结果、去重和压缩摘要。它还解析部分搜索运算符并对结果做宽松过滤。适合希望在 DSH 的 web_search 中使用多个搜索来源的场景。默认无需密钥；可选 API key 用于提高部分引擎的速率限制。

dsh-freeweb adds web search to DSH. It runs two engines concurrently, replaces failures with later candidates, and merges results by agreement while deduplicating and shortening snippets. It parses search operators and filters results. No key is required; optional keys can raise engine rate limits.
想让 DSH 的网页搜索同时参考多个搜索引擎。
有没有能在搜索源失败时自动换其他来源的 DSH 搜索提供方？
我希望网页搜索结果能按多个引擎的共同排名合并。
让 DSH 搜索网页时自动去重并缩短结果摘要。
I want DSH web search to combine results from multiple search engines.
Can DSH switch to another search source when one engine fails?
希望查询网页时能兼顾多种搜索服务，减少单一来源不可用的影响。
dsh-freeweb 的功能「多引擎并发与回退」：按配置顺序并发请求两个搜索引擎；失败时由队列中的后续引擎补位，直到得到结果或候选耗尽。
dsh-freeweb 的功能「跨引擎合并排序」：将成功引擎返回的结果按共同出现次数、最佳排名和稳定顺序合并，并规范化 URL 去重。
dsh-freeweb 的功能「搜索条件解析与过滤」：解析搜索查询中的部分站点、日期等条件，并对结果执行宽松过滤；可能清空结果的条件会被放宽并附加说明。
dsh-freeweb 的功能「摘要压缩」：在保留结果顺序的基础上缩短搜索结果摘要，为排名靠前的结果保留较多文本。
I want searches to keep working when one provider is unavailable.

dsh-freeweb README · dsh-freeweb：**A keyless web-search provider for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).**

The model calls the `web_search` tool with a query; the plugin runs two search
engines concurrently, merges their results into one list, removes duplicates,
and shortens snippets by rank. If an engine fails, the next one in the order
takes its place. No API key or account is required, and the default
configuration needs no changes.

dsh-freeweb README · Install it：Requires [Node.js](https://nodejs.org) ≥ 20.3 and dsh.

```sh

dsh-freeweb README · straight from GitHub — no npm account needed：npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add wiselfx/dsh-freeweb
```

```sh
section: straight from GitHub — no npm account needed

text:
dsh-freeweb README · or from a local checkout：npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-freeweb
```

Restart dsh. To check it loaded without searching anything:

```sh
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile web --dump-config   # expect searchProvider: freeweb
```

Pinned versions work too (`wiselfx/dsh-freeweb#v0.1.0`). More in
[docs/install.md](docs/install.md).

dsh-freeweb README · Enable in minimal mode：`minimal` mounts no `web_search` tool, so this plugin's results reach the
model only in `standard` and `ptc`. To add it, insert `tool-web` into the
`minimal` preset in your profile patch (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: preset-minimal
  config:
    plugins:
      - id: tool-web

Restart dsh, then confirm it loaded in `minimal` (not `standard`):

```sh
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile web --dump-config   # expect tool-web under preset-minimal
```

dsh-freeweb README · Which engines：Exa and Keenable run first. degoog, Startpage, DuckDuckGo and AnySearch are
fallbacks and take over when one fails. All six are keyless; optional keys only
raise rate limits.

dsh-freeweb README · Settings：The defaults require no changes. Engine order, timeouts and optional keys are
documented in [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md).

dsh-freeweb README · Testing：```sh
node test/offline.mjs                       # no network
node test/integration.mjs                   # every engine, live
node test/integration.mjs "your query"      # your own query
```
